title: Poster: Wavelet-Based Multiscale Analysis of Illumination and Noise
body: Presenting our wavelet-guided, zero-reference low-light enhancement work ("Enhance Light, Not Noise") as a poster at a statistics conference. The idea: separate illumination from noise across frequency bands so brightening doesn't amplify artifacts.

title: EZ-DCE++ submitted to WACV 2026
body: Submitted EZ-DCE++: Low-Light Enhancement via Multi-Scale Exposure-Guided Feedback, with Dr. Aminul Islam and Dr. Ashok Kumar.

title: Launched the DADL Lab website
body: Designed and built a Flask website for the Data Analytics and Deep Learning lab at UL Lafayette.

title: Started my PhD at UL Lafayette
body: Began a PhD in Computer Science at the School of Computing and Informatics, and joined as a Graduate Teaching Assistant for CMPS 150 and CMPS 460.

title: Wrapped up two years at mPower
body: Closed my chapter as a Software Engineer at mPower Social Enterprises after two years of backend and database work.
